title: Diffusion-Based Synthesis of Complete 3D Biparametric Prostate MRI
title_zh: 基于扩散的完整双参数前列腺MRI 3D合成

paragraphs.en: Synthetic biparametric MRI (bpMRI) may help alleviate the limited availability of large and representative prostate MRI datasets for deep learning applications. In this work, we present a conditional 3D diffusion framework for anatomy-conditioned synthesis of complete prostate bpMRI from anatomical masks. The framework supports sequential synthesis, in which T2w and diffusion modalities are generated by separately trained models, and joint synthesis, in which all bpMRI modalities are generated simultaneously within a single model. Five configurations were trained using PI-CAI, FastMRI Prostate, and PROSTATEx datasets to investigate different conditioning schemes, target modalities, and synthesis strategies. Evaluation using distribution-based metrics, paired-image similarity, and qualitative assessment demonstrated the feasibility of both synthesis pathways. Joint synthesis achieved competitive distributional fidelity while generating complete bpMRI, whereas direct synthesis of ADC and computed high-b-value DWI outperformed their derivation from synthetic diffusion-weighted images.
paragraphs.zh: 合成双参数磁共振成像（bpMRI）可能有助于缓解深度学习应用中大规模、有代表性的前列腺MRI数据集稀缺的问题。 在本工作中，我们提出了一种条件式3D扩散框架，可基于解剖掩码进行以解剖为条件的完整前列腺bpMRI合成。 该框架支持序列合成，即T2w和扩散模态由分别训练的模型生成；也支持联合合成，即所有bpMRI模态在单一模型内同时生成。 我们使用PI-CAI、FastMRI Prostate和PROSTATEx数据集训练了五种配置，以研究不同的条件方案、目标模态和合成策略。 基于分布的指标、成对图像相似度以及定性评估表明，两种合成路径均是可行的。 联合合成在生成完整bpMRI的同时实现了具有竞争力的分布保真度，而对ADC和计算得到的高b值DWI的直接合成优于从合成扩散加权图像推导得到的结果。

paragraphs.en: Prostate cancer is one of the most common malignancies in men, with more than 1.4 million new cases estimated worldwide in 2022 [ 21 ] . Biparametric MRI (bpMRI) is central to the non-invasive assessment of clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa) within the PI-RADS framework [ 19 ] . A bpMRI examination comprises T2-weighted imaging (T2w) and diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) acquired at multiple b-values. From these acquisitions, quantitative apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) maps can be derived, while very-high-b-value DWI may be acquired directly or computed from lower-b-value images.

paragraphs.en: BpMRI is increasingly used in deep learning applications such as lesion detection, segmentation, and csPCa classification [ 7 , 4 , 6 ] . However, model performance and generalization depend on the availability of large and representative annotated datasets [ 3 ] . This limitation has motivated increasing interest in prostate MRI synthesis as a means of augmenting existing datasets with synthetic images that reproduce clinically relevant imaging characteristics for downstream model development.
paragraphs.zh: BpMRI 在病灶检测、分割和 csPCa 分类等深度学习应用中的使用日益增多 [ 7 , 4 , 6 ] 。 然而，模型的性能和泛化能力依赖于大规模且具有代表性的标注数据集的可用性 [ 3 ] 。 这一局限促使人们对前列腺 MRI 合成越来越感兴趣，即通过合成图像来扩充现有数据集，这些合成图像能够复现与临床相关的影像学特征，以支持下游模型的开发。

paragraphs.en: Early work on prostate MRI synthesis explored the generation of individual MRI modalities and paired diffusion images using 2D diffusion models [ 16 ] . More recently, several studies have extended prostate MRI synthesis to 3D volumes, including anatomy-conditioned T2w generation for segmentation augmentation [ 1 , 8 ] , clinically conditioned T2w synthesis [ 9 ] , and multimodal generation of T2w, high-b-value DWI, and ADC [ 10 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 早期关于前列腺 MRI 合成的工作探索了使用 2D 扩散模型生成单个 MRI 模态以及配对的扩散图像 [ 16 ] 。 最近，一些研究将前列腺 MRI 合成扩展到了 3D 体数据，包括用于分割增强的解剖条件化 T2w 生成 [ 1 , 8 ] 、临床条件化 T2w 合成 [ 9 ] ，以及 T2w、高 b 值 DWI 和 ADC 的多模态生成 [ 10 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Collectively, these studies demonstrate the feasibility of prostate MRI synthesis using diffusion models. However, anatomy-conditioned generation of complete 3D bpMRI from explicit prostate-zone and lesion masks remains largely unexplored. Furthermore, it remains unclear whether the diffusion component of bpMRI should be synthesized at the acquisition level by generating diffusion-weighted images and subsequently deriving ADC and computed high-b-value DWI, or directly at the biomarker level by generating ADC and computed high-b-value DWI themselves.
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，这些研究证明了利用扩散模型合成前列腺 MRI 的可行性。 然而，基于显式前列腺分区掩膜和病灶掩膜进行条件约束、生成完整三维 bpMRI 的研究仍基本处于空白。 此外，bpMRI 的扩散成分究竟应该在采集层面进行合成，即先生成扩散加权图像、再由此推导 ADC 和计算所得高 b 值 DWI，还是直接在生物标志物层面合成，即直接生成 ADC 和计算所得高 b 值 DWI 本身，目前仍不清楚。

paragraphs.en: To investigate these alternative synthesis strategies, we present a conditional 3D diffusion framework for anatomy-conditioned generation of complete prostate bpMRI from anatomical masks. The framework supports both sequential synthesis, in which T2w and diffusion modalities are generated by separately trained models, and joint synthesis, in which all bpMRI modalities are generated simultaneously within a single model. It further supports both acquired diffusion targets (LBV and HBV) and diffusion-derived targets (ADC and cHBV), enabling the evaluation of alternative routes for complete bpMRI synthesis. The framework builds upon Med-DDPM [ 5 ] and incorporates direct x 0 x_{0} prediction, anisotropy-aware resolution changes, and flexible conditioning and target configurations. Five model configurations were trained using PI-CAI, FastMRI Prostate, and PROSTATEx data to evaluate different conditioning schemes, target modalities, and synthesis strategies for complete bpMRI generation.

paragraphs.en: Three public datasets were used: PI-CAI [ 17 ] , comprising 1,500 bpMRI studies with T2w, ADC, and computed high-b-value DWI (cHBV); PROSTATEx [ 14 ] , comprising 346 mpMRI studies; and FastMRI Prostate [ 18 ] , comprising 312 bpMRI studies. PI-CAI provides prostate-zone and lesion annotations, while corresponding prostate and lesion masks were obtained for FastMRI and PROSTATEx. T2w, ADC, and cHBV were used from PI-CAI, whereas T2w, LBV, and HBV were used from FastMRI and PROSTATEx. FastMRI and PROSTATEx were preprocessed using QP-Prostate [ 15 ] , including image registration and quality control, yielding 235 and 281 usable studies, respectively. For PI-CAI, ADC and cHBV were registered to T2w using Elastix [ 12 ] , resulting in 1,158 usable studies. All volumes were resampled to 0.5 × 0.5 × 3.0 0.5\times 0.5\times 3.0 mm, prostate-centred cropped to 192 × 192 × 20 192\times 192\times 20 voxels, and intensity-normalized to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] .

paragraphs.en: In prostate bpMRI, DWI is acquired at multiple diffusion weightings, or b b -values, typically including a low- b b -value image (LBV, approximately 50 50 – 100 ​ s / mm 2 100~\mathrm{s/mm^{2}} ) and a high- b b -value image (HBV, approximately 800 800 – 1000 ​ s / mm 2 1000~\mathrm{s/mm^{2}} ). These acquisitions can be used to derive additional diffusion representations, including apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) maps and computed high- b b -value DWI (cHBV, approximately 1400 ​ s / mm 2 1400~\mathrm{s/mm^{2}} ). This motivates two alternative diffusion synthesis strategies: generation of the acquired diffusion images (LBV and HBV), from which ADC and cHBV can subsequently be derived, and direct generation of the diffusion-derived representations ADC and cHBV.
paragraphs.zh: 在前列腺双参数MRI（bpMRI）中，DWI在多个扩散加权水平（即 b 值）下采集，通常包括低 b 值图像（LBV，约 50–100 s/mm²）和高 b 值图像（HBV，约 800–1000 s/mm²）。 这些采集数据可用于导出其他扩散表征，包括表观扩散系数（ADC）图和计算生成的高 b 值DWI（cHBV，约 1400 s/mm²）。 这启发了两种可选的扩散图像合成策略：一是生成实际采集的扩散图像（LBV 和 HBV），随后从中导出 ADC 和 cHBV；二是直接生成由扩散图像导出的表征 ADC 和 cHBV。

paragraphs.en: Each diffusion target configuration was evaluated using both synthesis strategies supported by the proposed framework: sequential synthesis and joint synthesis. In sequential synthesis, a dedicated mask-conditioned model first generates T2w. A second model, conditioned on both the anatomical mask and the T2w volume, then generates either LBV/HBV or ADC/cHBV. During complete bpMRI synthesis, the generated T2w volume is used to condition the second-stage model. In joint synthesis, a single mask-conditioned model generates T2w together with either LBV/HBV or ADC/cHBV. The resulting experimental design comprises five model configurations, summarized in Table 1 .

paragraphs.en: M1 was trained using PI-CAI and FastMRI (1615/120 train/test cases), M2 and M4 using PROSTATEx and FastMRI (476/40), and M3 and M5 using PI-CAI only (1146/12), according to the availability of the target modalities.

paragraphs.en: All models were trained using Adam, scale-shift normalization, 250 diffusion steps, and the direct x 0 x_{0} -prediction objective. M1 and M2 used 64 initial U-Net channels (166.8M parameters), whereas M3–M5 used 96 channels (375.2M parameters). Learning rates were set to 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} for M1, M4, and M5 and to 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} for M2 and M3. All remaining optimization settings followed Med-DDPM [ 5 ] . To soften sharp boundaries in the anatomical condition, anisotropic Gaussian smoothing ( σ z = 0.4 \sigma_{z}=0.4 , σ x ​ y = 1.0 \sigma_{xy}=1.0 ) was applied stochastically to conditioning masks during training, with probabilities of 40% for M1 and 50% for M2–M5. Training minimized a voxel-wise L 1 L_{1} loss. For multi-target models, modality-specific losses were combined using empirically selected weights to balance learning across modalities.

paragraphs.en: The alignment between the real and synthetic image distributions was evaluated using FID [ 11 ] , KID [ 2 ] , and Precision and Recall [ 13 ] . Metrics were computed on the 20 axial slices of each volume, treated as independent samples. The synthetic volumes used for this evaluation were generated from an augmented set of PI-CAI anatomical masks. Augmentation was designed to increase anatomical variability and balance lesion-positive and lesion-negative cases, and included prostate-level transformations (flipping and scaling) as well as lesion-level transformations (flipping, translation, and transfer between anatomically similar prostates). The resulting set comprised 1,500 masks. Synthetic volumes were generated using the corresponding sequential and joint synthesis pipelines. In sequential synthesis, T2w volumes were first generated from the augmented masks and subsequently used, together with the masks, to generate LBV/HBV or ADC/cHBV. In joint synthesis, all target modalities were generated directly from the augmented masks. For each modality, synthetic volumes were compared with a size-matched real reference set: 1,500 real and synthetic PI-CAI T2w volumes, 1,158 real and synthetic PI-CAI ADC and cHBV volumes, and 516 real and synthetic FastMRI/PROSTATEx LBV and HBV volumes.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 FID [11]、KID [2] 以及 Precision 和 Recall [13] 评估了真实图像分布与合成图像分布之间的对齐程度。 指标在每个体数据的 20 个轴向切片上计算，并将这些切片视为独立样本。 用于该评估的合成体数据是由扩充后的 PI-CAI 解剖掩膜集合生成的。 扩充旨在增加解剖变异并平衡病灶阳性与病灶阴性病例，包括前列腺层面的变换（翻转和缩放）以及病灶层面的变换（翻转、平移以及在解剖结构相似的前列腺之间的转移）。 由此得到的掩膜集合共包含 1,500 个掩膜。 合成体数据使用相应的序列式和联合合成管线生成。 在序列式合成中，首先由扩充后的掩膜生成 T2w 体数据，随后将其与掩膜一起用于生成 LBV/HBV 或 ADC/cHBV。 在联合合成中，所有目标模态均直接由扩充后的掩膜生成。 对于每种模态，合成体数据均与尺寸匹配的真实参考集进行比较：1,500 例真实与合成 PI-CAI T2w 体数据、1,158 例真实与合成 PI-CAI ADC 和 cHBV 体数据，以及 516 例真实与合成 FastMRI/PROSTATEx LBV 和 HBV 体数据。

Metrics were computed within the prostate region and averaged across datasets when applicable. For models conditioned only on anatomical masks (M1, M4, and M5), these metrics should be interpreted as measures of case-specific anatomical consistency rather than reconstruction fidelity.

sents.en: For ADC and cHBV synthesis (Table 3 ), the sequential model M3 and the joint model M5 achieved very similar distribution-based performance.

paragraphs.en: This study presented a conditional 3D DDPM framework for anatomy-conditioned synthesis of prostate bpMRI, supporting both sequential and joint generation of T2w and diffusion modalities from anatomical masks. The results demonstrate the feasibility of both synthesis strategies. Joint synthesis showed modality-specific differences in distributional fidelity relative to dedicated models while generating complete bpMRI examinations within a single model. For diffusion-derived modalities, direct synthesis of ADC and cHBV consistently achieved better distribution-based performance than derivation from synthetic LBV and HBV, suggesting that errors introduced during diffusion-image synthesis may propagate to the derived representations.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究提出了一种条件式 3D DDPM 框架，用于基于解剖结构条件生成前列腺 bpMRI，支持从解剖掩膜出发对 T2w 和扩散模态进行序列式生成与联合生成。 结果证明了两种合成策略的可行性。 相比专用模型，联合生成在分布保真度上表现出模态特异性差异，同时能够在单个模型内生成完整的 bpMRI 检查。 对于扩散衍生模态，直接合成 ADC 和 cHBV 始终比从合成的 LBV 和 HBV 推导获得更好的基于分布的性能，这表明扩散图像合成过程中引入的误差可能传播到衍生表示中。

paragraphs.en: Although the quantitative evaluation and qualitative examples support the plausibility of the generated images, further validation is required to determine whether diagnostically relevant characteristics are preserved and whether the generated data provide clinical value. Future work will therefore include expert radiological assessment and evaluation in downstream tasks such as csPCa classification, lesion detection, and prostate segmentation.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管定量评估和定性示例支持了生成图像的合理性，但仍需进一步验证以确定与诊断相关的特征是否得以保留，以及生成的数据是否具有临床价值。 因此，未来的工作将包括专家放射学评估以及在下游任务中的评价，例如 csPCa 分类、病灶检测和前列腺分割。
